messages:
ana: FYI support ticket from zephyr-corp - SSO logins intermittently failing and SCIM user updates returning 403. Started ~09:12 UTC after our RBAC rename push (infra-admin -> infra-operator). anyone seen similar?

kai: pinging infra-ops. can you drop the relevant provisioner and idp-proxy lines?

ana: pasted from provisioner (09:13):
```
2026-03-24T09:13:02Z provisioner ERROR tenant=zephyr-corp op=PATCH /scim/Users/847 status=403 msg="envelope unwrap failed: version=2 -> expected=3" err=KeyVersionMismatch
2026-03-24T09:13:03Z kms-client WARN tenant=zephyr-corp decrypt alias=alias/redwood-zephyr ctx=service-account-enc err=NotFound
```

rav: KeyVersionMismatch + alias NotFound suggests we rotated the customer alias and bumped envelope version but some service accounts still present with old envelope version. Did we schedule a rewrap backfill?

kai: we did rotate aliases at 08:50 UTC as part of the rollout. Backfill job launched but status shows some tenants stuck due to rate limits. zephyr-corp is in the queued slice.

ana: the SAML failures are probably related but logs show an assertion error too: idp-proxy at 09:12:59:
```
2026-03-24T09:12:59Z idp-proxy WARN tenant=zephyr-corp SAMLAssertion invalid_role_claim: received_role=infra-admin expected_any=[infra-operator, infra-admin-deprecated]
```

ana: looks like the client is still sending infra-admin in their assertion. We renamed role to infra-operator; should we accept the deprecated claim for a short window?

rav: We have an RBAC compatibility shim in auth-service. Currently it maps old->new for service names but not for role claims embedded in SAML. I can add a permissive mapping: accept infra-admin for 48h then log and metrics. low-risk?

kai: agree, do that while we complete rewrap. Also need to notify Support to ask zephyr to rotate their SP metadata if they control ACS/RelayState. Could be their client config is old.

ana: ops-bot, can you queue immediate rewrap for tenant zephyr-corp?

ops-bot: Command received: tenant-rewrap --tenant zephyr-corp --priority high. Job queued id=tr-20260324-99

rav: I'll deploy RBAC shim change to accept old role claim and emit a security-burst metric. pushing patch now.

security-bot: Metric created: rbac.legacy_role_claim.accept count. Alert suggested if >5/min per-tenant.

kai: rewrap job status:
```
2026-03-24T09:18:10Z tenant-rewrap INFO tenant=zephyr-corp job=tr-20260324-99 rewrapped=9/9 status=ok
2026-03-24T09:18:11Z provisioner INFO tenant=zephyr-corp retrying queued-scim count=2
```

ana: after rewrap, SCIM calls succeed. SSO shows fewer failures. Support confirmed a couple of clients still sending infra-admin; we accepted them via shim.

rav: action items: (1) make rewrap backfill auto-resume if rate-limited (ticket INFRA-2242), (2) add a pre-rotate check to ensure no in-flight SCIM ops for high-risk tenants, (3) implement a graceful RBAC claim-deprecation policy with 7-day grace and telemetry, (4) update runbook: "KMS alias rotate -> provisioning impact".

kai: also adding an audit log entry for the manual rewrap job and RBAC shim toggle.

ana: thanks team. closing the slack thread — will file incident note with JobID tr-20260324-99 and link to INFRA-2242. :white_check_mark:
